sloka: अतीव सा तु संहृष्टाअ कैकेयी विस्मयान्विता ।एकमाभरणं तस्यै कुब्जायै प्रददौ शुभम् ॥२-७-३२॥
transliteration: atīva sā tu saṁhṛṣṭāa kaikeyī vismayānvitā ।ekamābharaṇaṁ tasyai kubjāyai pradadau śubham ॥2-7-32॥

translations.english: Filled with immense joy and wonder (at the news), Kaikeyi gifted a beauthful ornament to that hunchback.
